scope: Five authorized implementation workstreams; no website, journal or trading-account changes

steps.change: Main and Larger C2 observation independent from Early entry permission. Valid TS/MPS survives Early off/FVG-OTE-only/C2 close. A stopped E remains stopped while a later raid can be observed; no second E. Freeze pre-raid P1/P2 before P3 becomes the latest confirmed pivot.
Bind source C1/C2 open/end and P3 timestamps. Handoff requires matching source/direction/C2 end/INV. Separate FROM C2, LOCAL C3, LOCAL TRACK. Do not automatically expire a live HTF CRT after C3.

Confirmed key-qualified Larger/Bias CRT context supplements structural bias. FLOW/CONT/KEY REV/HTF KEY REV/COUNTER SWING, optional qualified counter-parent reversal, B0 gate retained. No blind requirement that every timeframe agree.

Freeze nearest pre-known opposing HTF key ahead and before own range target. Delivery stops old leg entry reuse, while structural MPS observation may still occur. Old MPS cleared before another local leg; a new TS/key reaction is required. Own CRT INV/TGT remain independent.

Structure timeframe Chart/M15; default Chart. Independent closed M15 source swings/close on smaller charts, guarded lookahead_off cache, direct M15 charts supported. Entry stays on chart; no fixed fractal TF mapping.

coverage: Early off and no entry still retains MPS at last C2 close
